h,w=12,18
orig={(2,6),(2,12),(3,13),(4,13),(5,6),(5,7),(5,8),(5,10),(5,11),(5,12),(7,6),(8,13),(10,6),(10,12),(10,13)}
add=set()
for r in range(h):
    cs=sorted(c for rr,c in orig if rr==r)
    for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
        add.update((r,c) for c in range(a+1,b))
for c in range(w):
    rs=sorted(r for r,cc in orig if cc==c)
    for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        add.update((r,c) for r in range(a+1,b))
add-=orig
mat=[[8]*w for _ in range(h)]
for r,c in orig: mat[r][c]=4
for r,c in add: mat[r][c]=2
print(sorted(add))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in mat))
